summary.intent: Close out CipherBox plan 68.1-29's exit gate (full 208-spec web-client test suite verification), triage and fix failures, decide on deferrals, and address the one newly-discovered gap (deep shared-folder write support) via a follow-up plan (68.1-30) — all while running a confirmation suite to satisfy a prior round-2 verifier complaint.
summary.outcome: 8 of 11 original suite failures were fixed and re-verified green; 2 residuals and 1 new gap (nested shared-folder writes) were dispositioned for deferral/follow-up. Plan 68.1-30 was authored, ROADMAP-integrity-checked, and approved to fix the new gap via a new SDK resolver. Work is now paused awaiting the confirmation full-suite tally before executing 68.1-30 and running the final closing suite.

repo: CipherBox web: SharedWriteContext has no ipnsPrivateKey field — shared-write operations derive the publish key from inside the unsealed write-body (unsealParentWriteBody → publishNodeFn), so recovering a subfolder's writeKey alone is sufficient to enable deep shared writes; no key recovery needed for ipnsPrivateKey.

CipherBox web: writeKey seeding for shared folders only happens at the share root (68.1-20 scope boundary) — navigating into subfolders via navigateToSubfolder seeds a zero writeKey, causing GCM auth failures on subfolder write-bodies (writable-shares 8.2 gap).

Production bugs found during 68.1-29 triage: batch uploadFiles never inserted WriteChildRefs (uploaded files were un-savable); SharedFolderTree stored a zeroed writeKey (write shares were silently read-only for recipients); stale shared parent envelopes dropped write-links across same-session ops.

Owned-tree folder resolution uses a dfsFindFolder walk pattern (client.ts) that the new resolveSharedSubfolderWriteKey mirrors for the shared-tree case, matching WriteChildRef by childId===child.published.id (UUID) and using the parent-mirror childRef.generation for unsealChildWriteKey.

code.finding: dfsFindFolder walk used for owned-tree folder resolution; mirrored to build resolveSharedSubfolderWriteKey for shared-tree subfolder writeKey recovery.
navigateToSubfolder seeds a subfolder with a zero writeKey — root cause of the deep-shared-write gap (writable-shares 8.2).

workflow: Full suite test runs and a plan executor that edits source must not run concurrently — source edits would HMR the app mid-run and corrupt results; serialize them.
Planner-agent edits to ROADMAP.md carry a known truncation risk — verify file integrity (line counts, later phases preserved) immediately after any planner edit.
1Password-backed commit signing can time out with a false-negative even when the commit actually landed — verify via `git log` and clean tree status rather than trusting the timeout error.

friction: An earlier `cd docker` left the shell's cwd stuck, causing a verification command to run in the wrong directory; had to re-run with absolute paths.
Commit via 1Password-gated signing hit a timeout that looked like a failure but was a false negative — required manual git log verification to confirm the commit landed.
